desc: Offline pairing audit completed without a rig run. Apple's Mac16,8/J614s 25F84 BuildIdentity pairs J614S_MtpFirmware.im4p with J614s_Multitouch.im4p. The paired controller firmware is AppleMTPFirmwareMac-5340.61.4~438 and embeds SDK 25F63, exactly matching the live MTP report; its paired multitouch payload is the source of the existing a1f4131d... blob. Therefore restore build 25F84 versus controller SDK 25F63 is not a firmware mismatch. The observed failure is the post-upload interface reset command 0x40 in state 0, not upload command 0x95. Continue with reset-sequence, DMA-reachability, and command-specific telemetry work rather than another blob hunt.
author: claude

result.conclusion: Apple's paired artifacts prove these identifiers are compatible; the version-skew hypothesis is refuted.
